      description: case_name is required for Litigation Case File extraction.
      rule:

        rules:
          - op: present
            field: case_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: case_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: case_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(case_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: case-status-present

    - id: exposure-amount-non-negative
